heroHeadline: High Court Expanded Panel Debates Comptroller's Oct. 7 Probe; Bennett-Lapid Alliance Pledges Independent Inquiry — Day 947
heroSubtitle: The deadliest attack on Jewish people since the Holocaust — assault timeline, hostage crisis resolved January 2026, intelligence failures, and IDF response. On May 11, 2026 (Day 947 / Ceasefire Day 214), Israel's High Court of Justice convened an expanded 5-justice panel to debate whether State Comptroller Matanyahu Englman has authority to probe core political and security failures tied to October 7, 2023 — the court ended without ruling, challenging the comptroller for failing to interview IDF Chief Halevi and questioning jurisdictional scope. Two bereaved parents interrupted proceedings shouting 'October 7 is on your hands.' Former PM Naftali Bennett and opposition leader Yair Lapid announced a unified electoral alliance with an independent state commission of inquiry as their Day 1 governing commitment — a direct contrast to Netanyahu's alternative 'state-national' bill that removes the Supreme Court from commission appointments. 51 days remain until the Supreme Court's July 1 deadline for the government to present an investigation framework. Hamas's 1,195-death attack of October 7, 2023 — which triggered 251 hostage-takings (all accounted for as of January 26, 2026) and Operation Swords of Iron — remains the unresolved accountability wound at the heart of Israeli politics. Gaza ceasefire remains highly volatile: Israel controls 60%+ of Gaza, Hamas holds firm on disarmament refusal, 850+ Palestinians killed since October 2025 ceasefire, IDF operational plans for resumed offensive complete pending US authorization.
footerNote: Data sourced from IDF, Israel Police, UN OCHA, Israeli government, Bloomberg, Reuters, AP, Haaretz, Times of Israel, Jerusalem Post, WAFA, and institutional analyses. Casualty figures are official Israeli counts; Hamas-theater figures are separately noted and contested. All 251 hostages accounted for as of January 26, 2026. Cumulative conflict dead (Oct 7, 2023 – May 11, 2026): 72,600+ Palestinians per OCHA/Gaza MoH/WAFA. Ceasefire in effect since Oct 10, 2025; 2,400+ violations documented — 850+ Palestinians killed since ceasefire as of May 11, 2026 (ACLED: April 2026 deadliest month of year, 140 fatalities). May 11 (Day 947): High Court expanded 5-justice panel hears comptroller probe scope arguments — no ruling yet; court challenges comptroller for failing to interview Halevi; bereaved parents interrupt proceedings; Bennett-Lapid unified party pledges independent Oct. 7 commission as Day 1 priority; 51 days to Supreme Court July 1 investigation deadline. May 10 (Day 946): Security cabinet formally discusses Gaza war resumption; IDF destroys central Gaza terror tunnel; Haaretz: Netanyahu High Court filing characterized as implicit Oct. 7 admission. ICC arrest warrants for Netanyahu and Gallant remain active. Gaza reconstruction cost: $71.4B per UN-EU-World Bank joint assessment; <$1B of $17B pledged received.
